highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 advances to Skia m152 with Graphite bindings, asynchronous pixel reads, and runtime safety fixes.
highlights_body: It adds modern GPU capabilities while correcting ownership issues in image, region, pixmap, and runtime-effect paths.

bullets.detail: The release includes the m152 upstream renderer update and subsequent servicing corrections.
New bindings expose Graphite backends and backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels operations on images and surfaces.
Region iteration, pixmap subsets, raster image creation, and runtime-effect uniform resets correctly retain or release their native resources.

bullets.lead: Vulkan support and native symbols strengthened
bullets.detail: The Vulkan Silk.NET package returns to production and native symbol packaging improves diagnostics on Apple and Android.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Contributed managed and native runtime safety improvements

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: The release candidate completed m152 servicing, GPU support, and resource-lifetime fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced Skia m152, Graphite bindings, asynchronous pixel reads, and runtime safety work.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp receives managed performance and binding updates with the 4.152 release line.
